body: I felt an overwhelming urge to wrap my arms around him as if he was cold, but I also couldn't resist peering over his shoulder out of curiosity. His blue eyes were wide with tears streaming down his cheeks, making it seem like they could spill right into mine any second. I stood there for what seemed like minutes, holding onto that mix of protectiveness and intrigue before I finally turned away, feeling both responsible and slightly guilty for not being able to understand or fix whatever was bothering him.
